references.text: Direct parallel to Gen 36:31 with almost identical wording: a list of the kings who reigned in Edom before there was any king over Israel.
God promises Jacob that kings will come from him, which provides the background for the expression 'before any king reigned over the children of Israel'.
God's promise to Abraham that kings would descend from him, serving as the background for why Edom had kings before Israel did.
Balaam's prophecy that a ruler will arise from Israel and subdue Edom, relevant to the relationship between the kingdoms of Israel and Edom.
Israel's elders ask Samuel to appoint a king over them, marking the beginning of Israel's monarchy—long after Edom already had kings.
